name: Feed demo
description: A reference plugin library: one channel and five uploads, produced as ordinary episodes so they browse, sort, resume and sit under the household rating cap like anything else, a resolver that hands the server a stream when somebody presses Play, and a search hook that sends a result straight to the item it already made. Its catalog is a table it carries, and it is pointed at its own media, so it needs nothing on the internet. Used by the test harness.
author: Multipass

settings.label: Channel name
settings.help: What to call the show this library holds. It belongs to the library, so a second library from this plugin can name a different one.

settings.label: Where the files are
settings.help: The address the uploads are served from, ending in a slash. A real plugin gets this from its service; this one is told, so a test can point it at its own fixture.

settings.label: How the sync should end
settings.help: Drives the four endings a sync can have, so the harness can prove what each one does to a library. No real plugin has anything like this.

settings.label: How Play should answer
settings.help: ok returns the stream. auth returns it with a token the server must put on its fetch. error is what a service being down looks like. badhost returns an address this plugin never asked permission for, which the server refuses before fetching anything.

settings.label: How long a stream address is good for
settings.help: Set it low to watch the server ask again rather than reuse what it cached.
